$comment: Single source of truth for self-hosted WASM language runtimes. Entries are installed by scripts/download-runtimes.mjs into public/runtimes/<name>/<version>/ and always load same-origin — never from a third-party CDN at runtime. source 'node_modules' copies from the exact-pinned npm package (integrity guaranteed by package-lock.json); source 'url' downloads and verifies a SHA-256 checksum.

teavm-javac.$comment: javac 21 + TeaVM compiled to WASM-GC (konsoletyper/teavm-javac, Apache-2.0; OpenJDK parts GPLv2+Classpath-exception). Single-file Java 21 console programs; System.in not supported by the TeaVM console.

dotnet-wasm.$comment: C# (.NET 9 WASM + Roslyn in-browser compiler). Built locally via csharp-wasm-runtime/build.ps1 — requires .NET 9 SDK + wasm-tools workload. Output is committed to public/runtimes/dotnet-wasm/9.0/. Copy that folder to share with another machine.
